document.title: Forest Protection and Anti-Mining Bill Legal Provenance Ledger

claims.text: Parliament has legislative competence over forests under Entry 17A of List III (Concurrent List) of the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India.
claims.subsequent_history_checked: Inserted by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976.
claims.limitations: Central legislation prevails over state laws under Article 254(1).

claims.text: Article 21 of the Constitution encompasses the fundamental right to a clean, healthy environment and protection from climate degradation.

authorities.title: MK Ranjitsinh v. Union of India

claims.reviewer_action: Verified against Supreme Court official Judgment.

claims.text: Article 368 governs the procedure for amending the Constitution, requiring a special 2/3rd majority of members present and voting and ratification by States for special subjects.
claims.subsequent_history_checked: Subject to Basic Structure limits established in Kesavananda Bharati (1973).
claims.limitations: Entrenchment of statutory repeal procedure requires Constitutional Amendment under Art 368.
